reviews.title: Sad Digression
reviews.text:
The current state of Epic Seven is disheartening and disappointing. The reliance on gear farming and praying to the RNG gods has only gotten worse. With every new character requiring 300 or more speed, the odds of rolling gear with those stats feel almost impossible. In five-plus years of playing, I only have one character with close to 300 speed.
Character drop rates feel like they've worsened, and when you finally receive a custom unit selector ticket, the restrictions on available characters straight-up suck. They suck even more for veteran players who already own most—if not all—of the current roster and have their units SSS-imprinted.
Core modes like Guild War and Arena are constantly placed under maintenance, interrupting daily gameplay and ongoing events. New side stories are becoming entirely RNG-focused and simply aren't worth investing time into—the chances of collecting all the rewards from the latest side story were slim to none because of the brutal RNG mechanics.
The game has become increasingly whale-dominated, and with every new character released in a busted state, PvP modes are completely unbalanced. To top it off, the current anniversary event is awful—it has been plagued with bugs that leave major parts of the content completely unplayable.

reviews.title: Slow Squeeze
reviews.text:
Game is meant to give you rewards up front and access to the latest power creep units, anniversary units are the best example.
Over time resources are not available to obtain the later power units and force you to pay or the game is unplayable.
My experience is that no mystic hero can be summoned without going to full pity.  Galaxy bookmarks yield no 5 star units.  Seems like the streamers are on the other side of the statistical distribution by design.
Gameplay is fun until you are met with the inability to compete due to the aforementioned.  Not recommended to play this game as long term disappointment is inevitable.
